facts.value: The attached-object slot has an empty state identified by HSD_GOBJ_OBJ_NONE and an occupied state identified by another kind value. Registration is permitted only from the empty state. Destructive removal is likewise a no-op when empty, but when occupied it invokes the kind-specific callback before transitioning the slot to empty.
